objective: Tune progressive carve response and rough-surface isolation with the lightest reversible mechanisms before considering independent suspension.

vendor_guidance.inside: tightest turns / maximum carve; explicitly described as suitable for lightweight riders or riding without bindings
vendor_guidance.outside: all-around carve/stability balance; described for average riders with bindings

vendor_guidance.agent_reference: MBS Agent electric examples use Orange medium blocks inside for a carvey stock setup and describe moving them outside for higher-speed stability

vendor_guidance.inside: vendor describes for very heavy riders riding without bindings
vendor_guidance.outside: vendor describes as extreme high-speed / straight-line stability oriented

truck_references.vendor_character: electric-focused / carvey stock setup / wide drive clearance

compliance_layers.role: highest-frequency trail chatter, obstacle conformity, loose-surface contact
compliance_layers.default_policy: qualify 200x50 tire family and approved pressure range before adding tire mass/width

compliance_layers.role: steering resistance, rebound, recentering and carve/stability balance
compliance_layers.default_policy: use received Matrix III hardware and position adjustment before purchasing another hardness

compliance_layers.role: first-order agility/stability lever where chassis supports adjustment
compliance_layers.default_policy: Warren-only controlled 910/940/970mm experiment; keep other variables fixed

compliance_layers.role: slower flex/torsion plus local high-frequency attenuation
compliance_layers.default_policy: compare real received deck behavior; static envelope tests cannot establish flex

compliance_layers.role: expand steering resistance/rebound range if stock block position cannot close the handling target
compliance_layers.default_policy: defer purchase until stock block-position experiment shows a deficiency

compliance_layers.role: extra flotation and compliance if 200x50 proves deficient
compliance_layers.default_policy: Explorer/T2 remain gated because of mass, hub and brake-interface penalties

compliance_layers.role: large vertical isolation when rigid-platform compliance stack is measurably insufficient
compliance_layers.default_policy: fallback only; reopen architecture rather than bolt on an ad-hoc suspension

benchmarks.architecture: single large pneumatic tire + active self-balancing ride shaping
benchmarks.lesson: large tire air volume and ride shaping are useful product-level references, but single-wheel self-balancing dynamics are not directly transferable to a four-wheel mountainboard
independent suspension is a credible rough-terrain solution but its system mass is incompatible with treating suspension as a free comfort upgrade in Rev-C

experimental_invariants: Change one primary compliance variable at a time.
Keep course and IMU mounting fixed within a comparison block.
Compare repeated runs at matched low speed; vibration metrics are speed-dependent.
Tire-pressure experiments must stay within the tire/wheel manufacturer's approved range and begin symmetrically front/rear.
No powered compliance test is authorized by this snapshot or its analysis tools.
Subjective snowboard feel is recorded separately from objective vibration/steering metrics; neither is collapsed into a single score.
Independent suspension reopens only after the lightweight compliance stack shows a measured deficiency.

procurement_policy.rationale: Use received stock geometry/position, tire setup and chassis-specific wheelbase first; new parts should close an observed deficiency.
